title: 500 Yen - Reiwa

composition.text: Bimetallic: copper-nickel clad copper centre in nickel brass ring (75% Copper, 12.5% Zinc, 12.5% Nickel)

obverse.description:
Paulownia flowered branch in the center with issuer above, value below
and micro lettering near the rim.
obverse.lettering:
Japan
日 本 国
500 YEN (x2)
五 百 円
Japan
obverse.lettering_translation:
State of Japan
Five hundred yen

reverse.description:
Large numerical value in center with latent images in zeros, flanked by
Tachibana oranges (Citrus reticulata tachibana), bamboo on top and date below.
reverse.lettering:
500
500 YEN (x2)/JAPAN (x2)

令 和 三 年

comments:
See Quantity of Mint Sets and Proof Sets at 1 Yen page.

Issued on November 1st, 2021. It was planned to be issued in the early of 2021 but due to COVID-19 situation in Japan, preparation of vending machines and ATMs were delayed. On January 22nd 2021 the Ministry of Finance announced that the release will be postponed. On April 27th 2021, it was announced that the coin was to be issued in November. The production of the coins began on June 21st.

Security feature "500 円 and JAPAN" inside the 0's when held at angle

©Bank of Japan

edge.description: Slanted reeding with two different pitches
